text: Orb of Lorica is a quest reward from In the Name of the Light which is given by Raleigh the Devout in Hillsbrad Foothills.
The Orb of Noh'Orahil is a quest reward from The Completed Orb of Noh'Orahil.
__NOTOC__ Orb Collecting Totem is provided for Gather the Orbs. This totem is able to collect Razaani Light Orbs into it.
The prerequisite for this quest is the Grark Lorkrub (quest) questline.
Or'Kalar's Head drops from Or'Kalar in the Arathi Highlands.
Orc Captives are found inside cages in the Maker's room of the Blood Furnace. One of the cages opens up when the Maker is slain, but the orcs continue to stand inside.
The Orb of Returning is found inside the Fireproof Satchel provided for Call of Fire.
The Ooze Buster is provided as an objective for Corrosion Prevention.

The Opera Hall in Karazhan lies beyond the Grand Ballroom. It is the site of the Opera event, in which the player participates in one of three plays: Romulo and Julianne, Big Bad Wolf, or Wizard of Oz. Barnes, the stage manager, can also be found here and is the starter of the event. Sebastian, the organist, plays on the room's organ, and details of the grand chamber's lavish decorations can still be seen. During the Return to Karazhan, the Opera Hall has replaced its previous selection with three new plays: Beautiful Beast, Westfall Story, and Wikket.
The Opal Runestone is looted from the Pillar of Opal in Lethlor Ravine in the Badlands.

Follow the braziers west of the entrance to Blackfathom Deeps and turn north once reaching the water. Use the item close to the bonfire and pillars. Only the scripted Humanoids in the area will be made . All other mobs are still .

This is a page listing loot to be found in Opening the Dark Portal. For information about the instance itself, see Opening the Dark Portal. __TOC__
The Opportunist's Leather Helm is a reputation reward; you must be with Cenarion Expedition to purchase it for from in Zangarmarsh.
The Opportunist's Leather Legguards is a reputation reward; you must be Honored with The Sha'tar to purchase it for from in Terokkar Forest.
The Opportunist's Leather Spaulders are a reputation reward; you must be Honored with Keepers of Time to purchase it for from in Tanaris.
The Opportunist's Leather Gloves is sold by for . You must also be with Thrallmar to purchase them.
The Oracle Crystal dropped from Slitherblade Oracles in Desolace.

The Oracles are a faction of several friendly gorloc tribes that inhabit Sholazar Basin. They see themselves as guardians of the titan technology that remains in the area, though they don't really have an understanding of the artifacts they are guarding. They find themselves in an escalating territorial war with the Frenzyheart Tribe of wolvar. Though they are the sworn enemies of the wolvar, the oracles seem to have a nearly identical social system. Grunt work is done by the warriors, but their cultural leaders are nearly always great shamanic practitioners. Many of the Oracles' leaders have the word "Soo" in their name. This may be a title, especially since Jaloot says that someday the adv
The Open To Pass Your Rite. is located in the cave towards Ravenholdt Manor in Hillsbrad Foothills. Only rogues can interact with this chest.
Orbaz Bloodbane, nicknamed the "Hand of Suffering", is a human death knight in the service of the Scourge.
map of the First War.]] The Orc Camp was a site used by the orcs during the First War. On a map it is shown as being southeast of the Deadmines, nearly surrounded by forest.
Oracle Soo-nee is an elite gorloc found in Rainspeaker Canopy of the Sholazar Basin.
Opaque Dark Jade is a gem crafted by a jewelcrafter from a Dark Jade.
__NOTOC__ The Oracle Talisman of Ablution is a reputation reward; you must be with The Oracles to buy it from for .
Opaque Forest Emerald is crafted by Jewelcrafters with a skill level of 390. The components are: *1x Forest Emerald This recipe is taught by Design: Opaque Forest Emerald, sold by * *
This item gives a chance to deal poison damage to targets, which might boost you DPS a little. The buff will be removed when exiting Sholazar Basin.
Opposed Stasis Leggings drop from Commander Stoutbeard and Commander Kolurg in the Nexus.
The Orb of the Nexus is a large orb that will transport you out of the Oculus.
Opening of the Dark Portal is a dungeon & raids achievement earned for defeating the final boss of the Black Morass instance on normal or heroic difficulty.
Oracle Soo-dow is an elite gorloc quest giver located at Rainspeaker Canopy in Sholazar Basin.
__NOTOC__ Oracle Soo-rahm is a gorloc quest giver located in Sholazar Basin. He refers to himself as "Rahm".
Orbit-uary (25 player) is a dungeon & raids achievement earned for defeating Flame Leviathan with 4 Orbital Defense Systems active on 25-player mode.
Orbital Bombardment (25 player) is a dungeon & raids achievement earned for defeating Flame Leviathan with 1 Orbital Defense System active on 25-player mode.
The Oracle Orphan Whistle is provided to players who start the Little Orphan Roo Of The Oracles quest chain during Children's Week in Dalaran. It can summon Roo.

Orale Ownage is a 30 minutes lasting buff that is granted by Oracle Secret Solution, brought from Oracles Quatermasert for roughly 25 silver. The buff grants 5% movement speed increase and chance to deal poison damage. It can only be used in Sholazar basin.
Orange Marigolds are sold by Chapman during the Day of the Dead.

The Oratory of the Damned is a large chamber inside Icecrown Citadel, just off the main Spire chamber. Within, the lich Lady Deathwhisper preaches the word of her foul master to members of the Cult of the Damned. Once Lady Deathwhisper has been defeated, the platform on which she stands as you enter the room will become an elevator up to the Rampart of Skulls and the upper reaches of the Citadel.

The chain of quests around the Operation: Gnomeregan event. Any alliance character can complete all the quests except for the last two. You must be level 75 or higher to be able to complete the last two. While these quests have prerequisites, it is less a narrative than a series of nearly independent tasks.
The Orb of Suggestion is an orb of mind control that can dominate the will of a Famished Great Shark in Kelp'thar Forest.
:For the Alliance version of this quest, see The Brothers Digsong.
The Orc Blood Text is an archaeology keystone. It acts as 12 pieces of Orc Archaeology Fragments in research on Orc archaeology finds that have 'sockets'.
Oostan Nord is a pygmy village in northern Oostan on the Lost Isles. This village is led by the witch doctor Gaahl.
Oostan Ost is a pygmy village in southern Oostan on the Lost Isles. This village is led by the witch doctor Teloch.
Oostan Ost is a pygmy village in central Oostan on the Lost Isles. This village is led by the witch doctor Malmo.
Orc-Shock Spaulders is a quest reward from Dragonmaw Takedown.

__NOTOC__ Ophelia is a naga sea witch responsible for the destruction of several Alliance ships and the deaths of untold crew within the Obsidian Breakers in the Twilight Highlands. Her sweet music, coupled with her night elf illusion, proves too much for many to resist. Ephram Hardstone asks adventurers to help kill for the quest Siren's Song (quest). She first appears as a night elf rising from the sea only. When she reveals her true form, she kills the entranced Stranded Crewmen gathered around her.
__NOTOC__ Opuno Ironhorn is a tauren blacksmithing trainer located in the Valley of Wisdom in Orgrimmar. After Vol'jin's death, he was seen speaking with Kaja.
Opal Stonethrowers are gemstone colossi located on the Twilight Precipice in Deepholm during Therazane's assault on the Twilight's Hammer.

Opened Mosh'Ogg Bounty is a quest item provided for Airwyn Bantamflax (quest), Dask "The Flask" Gobfizzle (quest), I'm A Huge Liar and a Fraud, and Results: Inconclusive. It is an objective of The Universal Key from Mosh'Ogg Bounty.

Opening the Door starts the Firelands Invasion quest chain proper, added in Patch 4.2.0. Players must have completed the Mount Hyjal storyline up to and including Aessina's Miracle in order for this quest to open up at the Sanctuary of Malorne in the Regrowth of Mount Hyjal.

Orc Battlesworn are orc warriors first encountered by goblin players at the Alliance Beachhead on the Lost Isles. They can be found at various other locations on the Isles as well. At the Beachhead they are drawing off the Alliance defenders so that players may make their way to the Gyrochoppa.
__NOTOC__ Orachi is a jinyu found at Inkgill Mere in Kun-Lai Summit.
The Orc-Hair Braid is provided by Guardian Gurtar as an objective for Gurtar's Request.
Oracle Hiss'ir is a saurok located in the Briny Muck in the Dread Wastes.
Optimistic Benj is a rare turtle in Old Hillsbrad Foothills. He sits on top of a waterfall, just south of the road. He is the younger, less jaded version of Cranky Benj.

Optimo is a rare mechanostrider, a creation of Bingles Blastenheimer who rebelled with jealousy when he was working on his new invention, the Skystrider. It is rarely encountered in Ironwing Cavern while on Bird is the Word.
Orange-Painted Turnip is provided by Li Li for Crouching Carrot, Hidden Turnip.
__NOTOC__ Orb of Mystery is sold by Big Keech in The Golden Pagoda in Vale of Eternal Blossoms for .
The Opalescent Blue Crab Shell drops rarely from Azure Prickly Crawlers at Zouchin Strand in Kun-Lai Summit.

Oozer is a level 5 battle pet found next to its tamer Analynn in Ashenvale. Since it is an already tamed pet it cannot be caught, and the rusty snails of the area uses a different skin, snails with this specific skin can be found in many other locations.
Oratorium of the Voice is the chamber found after the Palace Antechamber in the Heart of Fear. It is here Imperial Vizier Zor'lok resides.

Operation: Shieldwall is the major Alliance force for the Pandaria campaign of the Alliance-Horde war. Its Horde counterpart is the Dominance Offensive. This is likely the Seventh Fleet mentioned in The King's Command.
Or'Dac is an ogre from the Brackenwall Village in Dustwallow Marsh found at Domination Point in Krasarang Wilds.

Operation: Shieldwall Campaign is a alliance-only quest achievement earned for completing the listed Operation: Shieldwall story lines. Adventurers will need to get to with Operation: Shieldwall to complete this achievement, which will take a week or two.
Oondasta is a devilsaur world boss found on the Isle of Giants, north of Kun-Lai Summit, on Pandaria. Oondasta is no tap and respawns every 15 minutes.
Oondasta Guild Run is an achievement that is awarded for defeating Oondasta on the Isle of Giants in a raid with at least 8 guild members.
Operation: Darkspear Destruction was found at on some crates by the dock of Dranosh'ar Blockade, outside of Orgrimmar in northern Durotar.

The Oona are a tribe of hozen pirates that roam the seas leaving destruction in their wake. The Oona land their boats on fertile soil, pillage the local villages, and drain the land dry before moving on to their next conquest. Currently they are found in northeastern Jade Forest in the Oona Kagu cave, where they have been looting the Sri-La Village.

Orac is an orc child of the Frostwolf clan from Wor'gol that can be found in a small cave at the Southwind Cliffs in Frostfire Ridge. In his eagerness to prove himself, he wandered off, following his companion Icepaw down towards saberon territory. There, he was cornered by the local pack's leader, Clawtooth. After adventurers free him, he returns home with an exaggerated tale of his victory. His uncle, Gog'rak, acknowledges that he reminds him of himself when he was young. Once he's returned home, he and Icepaw can be found running around near Gog'rak and Frosthoof.
Ophiis is an eel found swimming in the central rivers of . When first killed, Ophiis will drop Positive Pantaloons along with some Garrison Resources.

{{tooltip-wc3 |mode={} |arg={} |name=Orb of Corruption |icon=BTNOrbOfCorruption |class=Miscellaneous |desc=Attacks reduce armor. |sell=187 |stockreplenish=120 |hotkey=B }} Adds 5 bonus damage to the attack of a Hero when carried. The Hero's attacks also become ranged when attacking air and reduce the armor of enemy units by 5 for 5 seconds.
Operator Thogar is a boss in Blackrock Foundry, and the second boss in the Iron Assembly wing. He is responsible for managing the Iron Horde's Grimrail system.
Oozing Amulets can be fenced to Griftah using the Secretive Whistle for Dingy Iron Coins.
Opal Amulets can be fenced to Griftah using the Secretive Whistle for Dingy Iron Coins.
__NOTOC__ Oppressor's Merciless Treads drop from Tyrant Velhari in .

{{tooltip-wc3 |mode={} |arg={} |name=Orb of Darkness |icon=BTNOrbOfDarkness |level=6 |class=Permanent |desc=Attacks can create Dark Minions. |sell=300 }} Adds 6 bonus damage to the attack of a Hero when carried. The Hero's attacks also become ranged when attacking air and will create a Lesser Dark Minion when it is the killing blow on an enemy unit. The Dark Minion lasts 80 seconds.
__NOTOC__ Opheron is a blood elf follower located at the Frostwall in Frostfire Ridge. She can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Frostwall Tavern.
Oona Tuna-Catchers are part of the Oona tribe. They can be found within Oona Kagu on the northeastern shore of the Jade Forest.
Ooze-Soaked Shirt is a quest reward from Splat (quest). To complete the quest, you must successfully challenge Splat.

Orb of Banishment is an orb handed by Lulubelle Fizzlebang to warlock adventurers in order to banish demons. She wish to banish them back to the Twisting Nether so people will not blame her for their presence at Stormheim.

Orc Ancestors are the souls of deceased orcs that are found inside Oshu'gun in Nagrand. Void energy has been devouring the souls of the Orc spirits that once inhabited the ship, consuming them into a vortex.
Opera Hall: Wikket is one of the three encounters in the Opera Hall in Return to Karazhan.
Opera Hall: Westfall Story is one of the three encounters in the Opera Hall in Return to Karazhan.
Opera Hall: Beautiful Beast is one of the three encounters in the Opera Hall in Return to Karazhan.
The Orb of Inner Chaos is a common archaeology artifact that requires 140 Demonic Archaeology Fragments to solve, and allows use of two keystones.
Or'ligai is a nightborne who made several eggs for Elisande. His whereabouts are unknown.
Open Wounds is a Feral druid artifact trait. It is linked to the Attuned to Nature and Ashamane's Energy traits.
Orbyth is a broken nightborne construct located at the Ley-Ruins of Zarkhenar in Azsuna. It later is reactivated to fight Senegos at Azurewing Repose.
Oracle Tidecress was a naga that was meeting with the Darkfiend satyr during the Burning Legion's third invasion. She was taken out by the druids of the Dreamgrove.
Opalescent Shell is a reward from One Who's Worthy (Azsuna).
Opening Moves was a weeklong series of official blogs exploring strategy in World of Warcraft eSports. The Midgame Moves continued the series.
__NOTOC__ Opengut Behemoths are found in Andorhal in the Western Plaguelands.
Operation Counterattack is a player vs. player achievement earned by defeating Kronus/Fangraal within 8 minutes of it being summoned by the opposite faction.
Oooki is a tortollan following the Trained Crab at the Seekers' Vista in Stormsong Valley.
__NOTOC__ Oostan Headhunters are pygmies located on the Lost Isles.
The Orb of the Fel Temptress has a low chance to drop from the Hellblaze Temptresses in the Cathedral of Eternal Night.
Operation: Grave Digger is automatically offered after entering Dazar'alor at 4,500 friendly reputation with the Honorbound.
Operation: Heartstrike begins the final chapter of the Alliance War Campaign and is offered upon reaching reputation with 7th Legion and completing A Clean Escape.
The Orange Glowing Puffer is looted from the Bowl of Glowing Pufferfish. Tossing the item at a player grants them the Bioluminescent buff.
Oprescu's Gilded Touch is a world drop. They may have belonged to Serban Oprescu.
The Ooze Release Valve is located in Rotface's room of the Plagueworks of Icecrown Citadel.
Orb Guardians are sethrak located in the Bazaar of Watchful Eyes in the Temple of Sethraliss.

Opulence is the fourth boss in the Battle of Dazar'alor raid. In this encounter, the Alliance faces off against the enchanted treasures of the Zandalari Empire. This encounter is part of the Battle of Dazar'alor raid where Horde characters are transformed into soldiers of the Alliance.
The Orb of the Drowned is summoned by Blindlight located in the Darkwater Cavern in Nazjatar.

Operation: Mechagon - The Mechoriginator is the final quest in the Mechagon storyline. This quest is required for The Mechagonian Threat; however, the objective can be marked as complete with a skip option, so you no longer need to actually run the dungeon to unlock the mechagnome allied race.
Operation: Mechagon Guild Run is a guild dungeon achievement that is earned for defeating King Mechagon in the Operation: Mechagon on Mythic difficulty while in a guild group.
Orange Spraybot summons Paintbot Orange. It is created with Junkyard Tinkering and rarely contained in Rustbolt Requisitions.
The Orange Orange is found throughout the Return to Karazhan. This fruit was added as part of the Riddle of Jenafur but is not required for it.
Orbs of Visions are looted from Corrupted Chests in the Vision of Stormwind and the Vision of Orgrimmar. They could be traded for gear at the Blacktalon Quartermaster in the Chamber of Heart.

Orbs of Darkest Visions were looted from Corrupted Chests in the Vision of Stormwind and the Vision of Orgrimmar. They could be traded for gear at the Blacktalon Quartermaster in the Chamber of Heart.
__NOTOC__ Orator Kloe is a kyrian located in Aspirant's Crucible in Bastion.
The Ooze-covered Amber drops from mantid rare mobs in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.
Oozing Vocal Sac drops from Veskan the Fallen in the Assault in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

Orbs of Madness were looted from Corrupted Chests in the Vision of Stormwind and the Vision of Orgrimmar while under the effect of at least one Faceless Mask. They could be traded for gear at the Blacktalon Quartermaster in the Chamber of Heart.
Orbs of Darkest Madness were looted from Corrupted Chests in the Vision of Stormwind and the Vision of Orgrimmar while under the effect of all Faceless Masks.
Operator's Mitts drop from K.U.-J.0. in Operation: Mechagon.
Optimized Logic Board drops from K.U.-J.0. and Gunker in Operation: Mechagon.
Optical Target Embiggeners are created with Engineering (75); taught by Machinist Au'gur in Oribos.
The Orb of Burgeoning Ambition is looted from a treasure chest guarded by two Adjudicators of Guilt in Pridefall Hamlet in Revendreth.
The Orb of the Abandoned Magi drops from Zuraal the Ascended in the Seat of the Triumvirate and has a chance to be looted from Relinquished Arcane Relic.
Opulence Ba'hare is a broker located in the Broker's Den in Oribos.
Ooze-Covered Fungus dropped from Savage Cave Beasts in Ahn'kahet: The Old Kingdom.
Open Palm Strikes is an Azerite trait available to Windwalker monks.

Oranomonos the Everbranching is a tirnenn world boss located at Tirna Scithe in Ardenweald while the world quest Oranomonos the Everbranching (quest) is available. The encounter is started by interacting with the Wilting Bud.
__NOTOC__ Opalescent Ink is crafted with Shadowlands Inscription for Inscription: Invocation of Duty.
__NOTOC__ Opalescent Pigment is provided for Inscription: Invocation of Duty.
The Orc Admirer is one of the four "hot babes" featured in Martek the Exiled's tale in The Day that Deathwing Came: What Really Happened in the Scar of the Worldbreaker in the Badlands. __NOTOC__
__NOTOC__ Orboreal Shards are sold by crafting vendors in Ardenweald and Oribos.
The Oozing Necroray Egg is created from a Necroray Egg after three days.
Orbital Precision is an Azerite trait for Frost mages. It doesn't appear to be available.
Opposing Orgrimmar is an Alliance-only PvP achievement earned by killing Rokhan, who is located inside Grommash Hold.

__NOTOC__ Ooz is a slime initially located at Plague Deviser Marileth's laboratory in the House of Plagues in Maldraxxus. After completion of The Door to the Unknown, a now significantly larger Ooz can be seen hiding in a corner of the Seat of the Primus. In the Covenant Sanctum version of the Seat, Ooz—now shrunken back to his old size—can be found next to Marileth in the northwestern laboratory.
Oozing Stygia are death elementals located in the Beastwarrens in the Maw.
Oracle Blood drop from Sparktouched Warriors and Sparktouched Oracles in the Sholazar Basin. Using it at the Shrine of Kartak summons Kartak the Abominable.
The Orboreal Distinguishment is sold by Purveyor Zo'kuul in the Enclave in Oribos for .
The Opalescent Tri-Ring can be created by a Formidable Ring.

Opalescent Guardians are earth elementals located in the Pale Roost in Deepholm. During the Burning Legion's third invasion, they fought against the Felrock troggs. The Disassembled Opalescent Guardians were reassembled, and they transported Stone Drake Eggs to Therazane's Throne.
Opal Defenders are gemstone colossi located in the Pale Roost in Deepholm.
Orb of Culmination is an orb located in Blackwing Descent. This orb starts the encounter Nefarian's End. It has the same model as Orb of Command.
Opening the Maw begins the second chapter of the Chains of Domination campaign, "Maw Walkers".
Marileth offers one of three versions of Oozing with Character when he's present at Keeper's Respite, all involving taking an ooze to the Mauler's Outlook and performing a similar task.

The Orb of Revelation is provided for the quests Spy vs Spy and The "Unwelcome" Guests of the Chains of Domination campaign and is used to reveal nathrezim disguises. Using the item provides a 5-second Spectral Sight-style buff on a 10-second cooldown. Nathrezim in the area will have purple wings and also be marked on the minimap.
Orboreal Carvings can be obtained by feeding weapons to Jaithys, the Prison Blade, or by scrapping Sanctum of Domination equipment at the Scrap-O-Matic 1000/Shred-Master Mk1.
The Orb of Enveloping Rifts drops from Torglluun in The Rift in the Maw.
Orbitwarp Culottes are dropped by So'azmi in Tazavesh, the Veiled Market.
Ooze-Coated Supply Crates are found at Skulk Rock in the Hinterlands.
Ooze-Imbued Rifle drops from mobs in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.
Oranomonos's Diaphanous Leggings drop from Oranomonos the Everbranching in Ardenweald.
Oracle Gloves are a world drop and are looted from Titanium Lockbox.
Oracle Circlet is a world drop and is looted from Titanium Lockbox.
Oracle Leggings are a world drop and are looted from Titanium Lockbox.
Oracle Mantle is a world drop and is looted from Titanium Lockbox.
Oracle Bracelets are a world drop and are looted from Titanium Lockbox.
Orb Fragments are found at the Terrace of Formation in Zereth Mortis.

Oracle Voraxxi is a Dominated automa oracle located on a platform overlooking the southern Endless Sands in Zereth Mortis. Along with Oracle Zoketh, she predicts the actions of the Maw Walkers and their allies on behalf of the Mawsworn, so Secutor Mevix wants her killed. __NOTOC__
Opeth is a Maldraxxi necromancer located in the Necrotic Wake.
Orb of Dark Portents were looted from Corrupted Chests after defeating Alleria in the Vision of Stormwind or Thrall in the Vision of Orgrimmar.
Oracular Mitts are looted from Tribute of the Enlightened Elders and Stolen Scroll.
Oracular Hood is looted from Tribute of the Enlightened Elders, Tarachnid Eggs and Discarded Automa Scrap.
Oracular Sash is looted from Tribute of the Enlightened Elders and Prying Eye Discovery.
Oracle's Chromatic Cuirass drops from Dausegne in Sepulcher of the First Ones.

Oracle Zoketh is a dominated automa oracle located just south of the Dread Portal in Zereth Mortis. Along with Oracle Voraxxi, she predicts the actions of the Maw Walkers and their allies on behalf of the Mawsworn, so Secutor Mevix wants her killed. __NOTOC__
The Orb of Transference is the Stolen Artifact sought after by Tahli. Once looted from Ilgaz the Plunderer, it can be placed on a mechanism, opening a door at the Arrangement Index in Zereth Mortis.
__NOTOC__ Opengut Abominations are abominations located in Andorhal in the Western Plaguelands.
Oracular Pantaloons are a quest reward from Overgrown Story and Motes of Knowledge.
Oracular Wrists are looted from Tribute of the Enlightened Elders, Prototype Schematic and Rondure Cache.

Orbis was the codename of a cancelled Warcraft mobile game. The game was in development by 2018. It was an augmented reality game, similar to [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pok%C3%A9mon_Go Pokémon Go]. It was canceled in 2022, around which point Warcraft Arclight Rumble was revealed.

__NOTOC__ Oozing Ingredient: Mephitic Goo is an ingredient for the Pool of Mixed Monstrosities at the House of Plagues in Maldraxxus. It drops from the Colossal Goos and Prodigious Animates in the area. Mephitic Goo is required for summoning Corrupted Sediment, Violet Mistake, and Oily Invertebrate from the Pool of Mixed Monstrosities.

__NOTOC__ Oozing Ingredient: Viscous Oil is an ingredient for the Pool of Mixed Monstrosities at the House of Plagues in Maldraxxus. It drops from the Burning Extracts and Colossal Plasmas in the area. Viscous Oil is required for summoning the Pulsing Leech, Violet Mistake, and Burnblister from the Pool of Mixed Monstrosities.

__NOTOC__ Oozing Ingredient: Miscible Ooze is an ingredient for the Pool of Mixed Monstrosities at the House of Plagues in Maldraxxus. It drops from the Diseased Remnants and Infectious Monstrosities in the area. Miscible Ooze is required for summoning Gelloh, Burnblister, and Boneslurp from the Pool of Mixed Monstrosities.
Ooz's Frictionless Coating is a soulbind trait granted by Plague Deviser Marileth. It is exclusive with Travel with Bloop and Plaguey's Preemptive Strike.
Oozing Lashers are lashers located in the Azure Vault. While initially burrowed, they will emerge when players get too close.
Opalfang's Earthbound Legguards drop from the Primal Council in the Vault of the Incarnates.
Orb of the Obsidian Scale is sold for from Dealer Vexil in Smoldering Perch in the Waking Shores after completing The Shadow of His Wings.
Oozing Decays are oozes located in the Brackenhide Outskirts in the Azure Span. They spawn when approaching decaying beasts. They also appear when examining tuskarr corpses during Another Ambush.
Operative's Bandolier is available for purchase for 250 Trader's Tender at the Trading Post.
Orbeck the Unknown is a tauren rogue found in the Hall of Shadows.
Oopa is a mammoth carrying Tika with Brena's caravan in central Azure Span, heading to Iskaara.

The Orb of the Sin'dorei is a toy that temporarily disguises the user as a Blood Elf. The gender of the disguise matches that of the user, and some other character attributes, such as hairstyle and skin color, cause consistent variations in the Blood Elf model used. Additionally, the user's own gear is still displayed. In contrast, the Orb of Deception's model is affected by the user's gender, weapon, and race, but does not reflect character customizations and armor.

monument.]] Orcish is the primary language of the orcs. It is used as the main language of the Horde. The main form of the Orcish language used by all orc tribes on Draenor was known as common Orcish. Separate clans had variations of dialect that differed so much that orcs could not understand each other unless they spoke the common tongue. There was an older, archaic version of Orcish that few but the highly educated, such as the shaman and the clan chieftains, knew. Written using runes, Orcish is regarded by non-speakers as an ugly, guttural language. Jaina Proudmoore is able to differentiate between pictographs from an old version of the orc language.

The Orgath'ar was an orcish trading ship build by the goblin Leyds and named for the orc Orgath who died fighting the Burning Legion. As a result of its goblin craftsmanship, the ship felt quite cramped to its orcish crew. Captain Bolik felt that it was important to look as little like the orcish slaves of old as possible, and groomed himself in a way very unusual for his people. He also instructed his crew to do the same, but only seaman Rabin had really taken to it. During a supply run to Razor Hill, the Orgath'ar was attacked by pirates under cover of fog. Lunk-tusk and he were sent to investigate tales returning hunters have told of the dead rising along one of the Tuskarr hunting trails. He is a quest giver in the Fury of the Kvaldir quest chain.

The orcish starting experience takes place in Valley of Trials, in southwestern Durotar. In this questline, players are sent out into the Valley to collect various materials and kill various enemies to prove themselves to Gornek. After Sting of the Scorpid, the player's class trainer asks for them and they leave Gornek behind to continue their training. Players finally help Zureetha Fargaze cleanse the Valley of the Burning Blade clan starting in the quest Vile Familiars. After clearing out the Burning Blade, Zureetha sends players to Sen'jin Village and the Durotar storyline begins!
